North Korea Fires Multiple Ballistic Missiles into Sea of Japan

North Korea launched several ballistic missiles into the Sea of Japan, according to South Korea's military. This action follows a recent hypersonic missile test by South Korea and is part of a continuing series of weapons tests by North Korea. One report mentioned the launch occurred days after South Korea's hypersonic test, while another noted it followed an AI missile test.
